name: text-morph
title: Text Morph
description: Text and numbers that morph in place when they change: shared characters glide to their new spots, the rest fade, digits roll by place value. No dependencies.
author: Lochie Axon <https://lochieaxon.com>
docs:
Installed `TextMorph` (`@/components/ui/text-morph`) and its engine (`@/lib/text-morph-engine`, `@/lib/text-morph-text`, `@/lib/text-morph-core`).

```tsx
import { TextMorph } from "@/components/ui/text-morph";

<TextMorph>{label}</TextMorph>
<TextMorph decimals={2}>{price}</TextMorph>
```

Change the children to morph. Pass text or numbers only. `useTextMorph()` gives the same engine for an element you render yourself. The motion follows `prefers-reduced-motion` by default.
